page.overview:
What is Drowzee?

Drowzee is a character that appears in Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Explorers of Time and Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Explorers of Darkness as well as Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Explorers of Sky.

In Chapter 3, the player and partner are introduced to Treasure Town as Bidoof gives them a tour of the guild and the town. While in Treasure Town, the player and partner check out the Kecleon Shop and meet the Kecleon brothers for the first time. Moments later, Marill and Azurill stop by the same shop and buy an Apple. Marill and Azurill then realize the Kecleons had given them two apples, and rush back to return the extra apple, but Kecleon tells them it is a gift and tells them to keep it. The Marill brothers leave, but Azurill trips and drops the Apple, which bounces towards the player. The player returns the Apple to Azurill but experiences a dizzy spell and hears a desperate shout for help. No one else heard it, so the partner believes it was the player's imagination, but the player insists that it was real and identifies the voice to be that of Azurill.

The player and partner move on, but before long, they see Marill and Azurill talking to Drowzee, who promised to help the Marill brothers find an item they had lost. The three then depart, but Drowzee bumps into the player, triggering the player's second dizzy spell. In this dizzy spell, the player sees Drowzee and Azurill at the top of Mt. Bristle and Drowzee threatens Azurill, "If you keep being difficult, it will mean big trouble for you!" After that, Azurill makes a desperate scream for help. The player tells his or her partner about this, but the partner doesn't believe it, until the two head back to the guild and see a report about Drowzee on the Outlaw Notice Board. With the help of Marill, they hurry to Mt. Bristle. When they get to the top, the player and partner find Drowzee and Azurill. Drowzee tells Azurill to crawl into the small hole in the back, claiming there is a "trove of thief treasure" in the hole. Presumably, this was an attempt at manipulation and a lie intended to cause further harm to Azurill, who did not fall for the trick. The partner demands Drowzee to stop, but Drowzee taunts the player and partner to be "total rookies" and believes he can defeat them easily. However, the player and partner defeat Drowzee and rescue Azurill. With Drowzee fainted, Magnezone is able to apprehend him and send him to prison. The Marill brothers sincerely thank them for rescuing them.
